recentItems.title: 🔴 Philadelphia, Pennsylvania PA - Live Weather Information - WSJr
recentItems.description:
Live weather information on the Jr. via custom data encoder module.

Location of shown forecast area changes based on specific weather criteria. Philadelphia, PA will be shown when the criteria is not met.

Donation link: https://ko-fi.com/cc17926

Picture of encoder module: https://www.flickr.com/photos/textfiles/52027645906/in/album-72177720298362240/

Hardware overview and power-up: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ls1rEXteXNk

Music is Trammell Starks playlist.

********* NOT FOR NAVIGATION, DO NOT RELY ON THIS DATA FOR DECISIONS THAT CAN RESULT IN HARM TO ANYONE OR ANYTHING. ******

recentItems.title: Second Found Tape Recording - Easy 101 (Philadelphia 101.1 FM) - Early 1983 !
recentItems.description:
The second found cassette tape from the local thrift store of Easy 101 .. This recording does include station identification, a news segment at 43:00 ,  a lengthy bumper for Strawbridge & Clothier's Clover Days at 52:52 , a weather forecast at 53:47 , Gulf Kerolite 1-K Kerosene Ad at 1:08:10 . Radio personality is Chris Johnson & Lee Martin. Exact date is questionable, but given the news/weather, it appears this may have been recorded early 1983. Enjoy!

Visuals provided by a PixelMusic 3000

recentItems.title: Dave Grusin - Mountain Dance (Limited Edition/Special Pressing) - Vinyl Record
recentItems.description:
This is the Limited Edition Special Pressing, says "An Arista/GRP Direct To Digital Recording" at top and "Limited Edition Special Pressing" at bottom.
Incidentally, this copy has two mis-placed side A labels.

Featuring: Dave Grusin, Marcus Miller, Harvey Mason, Jeff Mironov, Rubens Bassini, Ed Walsh, Ian Underwood

Fans of The Weather Channel will immediately recognize 'Friends and Strangers' which begins at 4:45 , which was heard at the launch of the network on May 2, 1982.

A1 - Rag Bag
A2 - Friends And Strangers
A3 - City Lights
A4 - Rondo - "If You Hold Out Your Hand"

B1 - Mountain Dance
B2 - Thanksong
B3 - Captain Caribé
B4 - Either Way

More information about this specific album: https://www.discogs.com/release/3924078-Dave-Grusin-Mountain-Dance

More songs used from Dave Grusin on The Weather Channel can be found here: https://twcclassics.com/audio/artists-d.html
